title: cse-coach practice-runner contract
description: The data contract emitted by scripts/export_practice.py from the hand-authored specs in dsa/tests/, and consumed by the progressiveoverflow.com practice page, which runs the viewer's Python in the browser against the stored cases. It carries inputs and expected outputs only: no reference solution is published, and no technique or pattern name appears anywhere in it. schemaVersion is bumped on any breaking change so a viewer can refuse an incompatible file. The specs are validated by `export_practice.py --check`; a malformed spec is a hard failure there, never a silently dropped problem.

problems.description: One entry per spec file, sorted by `number`.

number.description: The problem number, unique across the file and equal to the spec filename's leading number.

statement.description: Plain-text statement, examples and constraints included. null when the spec has none.

stub.description: The blank starting code. Begins with the typing import and runs unmodified.

compare.description: How a returned value is matched to `expected`: exact = equal as is; unordered = top-level list order ignored; unordered-nested = top-level order ignored and each inner list's order ignored; unordered-inner = each inner list's order ignored, outer order fixed.

figure.description: Optional. Names which `args` of a case hold a graph's edge list or a grid, so the site can draw each example's input. null when the problem has none.

types.description: Optional. Names the codec that builds each argument and decodes the result, for a problem whose values are not plain JSON (a linked list, a tree, a graph). null when the problem is plain JSON.

result.description: Optional. Where the value to check lives: the return value, or an argument the function mutates. null compares the return value.

signature.description: Optional. The method's typed signature, e.g. `strs: List[str] -> str`. The site's guard does not read it.

decodeSignature.description: Optional. The signature of a round-trip spec's decode half. The site's guard does not read it.

cases.description: At least one case has `example: true`.

types.description: Per-argument codecs and the result codec.

args.description: One entry per argument: the codec that builds it, or null for plain JSON. `number-inf` and `list-node-ref` only decode a result, so they are not allowed here.

result.description: The codec that decodes the returned value, or null for plain JSON. `list-node-ref` decodes a returned node to its 0-based index among the nodes built for the first `list-node` / `list-node-cycle` arg.

oneOf.description: Check an argument the function mutates (arg), or a prefix of it (arg-prefix).
Graph from an edge list; nodeCountArg adds isolated nodes.

edgesArg.description: Index into a case's args: the edge list, [u, v] or [u, v, w].

nodeCountArg.description: Index into a case's args: the node count, so isolated nodes are drawn.

nodesArg.description: Index into a case's args: the node list.

edges.description: Draw only the pairs in a case's expected answer, labeled from the matrix; absent draws lines from the input. Not together with highlight.

matrixArg.description: Index into a case's args: a square matrix.

oneOf.description: Graph from an adjacency list; oneBased when node labels start at 1.

adjArg.description: Index into a case's args: the adjacency list.

gridArg.description: Index into a case's args: the matrix.

expected.description: The expected return value, any JSON value. A mapping whose only key is `anyOf`, holding a non-empty list, matches any one of its entries under the problem's compare mode; in an ops case an element of the expected list may be such a mapping.

example.description: True for a case taken from the statement's own examples.

judge.description: Optional. Judge APIs to bind as globals before the call, name to integer, e.g. `{isBadVersion: 4}`. Not an argument.

figureCells.description: Optional, on an example case of a grid figure. [row, column] cells the figure draws as found.
